items.prompt: What are your future aspirations, and what steps have you taken toward achieving them? Why do you believe POSTECH is the right place to pursue your goals, and what are your academic plans during your university studies?
items.ru: Вопрос 1 личного заявления: о будущих целях и шагах к ним, почему POSTECH и какие учебные планы. До 500 слов.
items.evidence: What are your future aspirations, and what steps have you taken toward achieving them? Why do you believe POSTECH is the right place to pursue your goals, and what are your academic plans during your university studies? (Maximum: 500 words)

items.prompt: Describe the STEM-related activity that has been most meaningful to you. Why was it significant, how did you engage with it, and what did you learn or gain from the experience?
items.ru: Вопрос 2 личного заявления: самое важное для вас занятие в STEM — почему оно значимо, как вы в нём участвовали и что вынесли. До 200 слов.
items.evidence: Describe the STEM-related activity that has been most meaningful to you. Why was it significant, how did you engage with it, and what did you learn or gain from the experience? (Maximum: 200 words)

items.prompt: Reflect on a time when you collaborated in a learning or team environment with individuals whose ideas or backgrounds differed from your own. How did you approach the situation, and what did you take away from the experience?
items.ru: Вопрос 3 личного заявления: случай совместной работы с людьми других взглядов или опыта — как вы действовали и что поняли. До 200 слов.
items.evidence: Reflect on a time when you collaborated in a learning or team environment with individuals whose ideas or backgrounds differed from your own. How did you approach the situation, and what did you take away from the experience? (Maximum: 200 words)

items.prompt: If applicable, please share any special circumstances-such as personal or familyrelated challenges-or additional information that would help us better understand your background, experiences, or difficulties you have overcome.
items.ru: Вопрос 4 личного заявления — если есть особые обстоятельства или то, что помогает понять ваш опыт и преодолённые трудности. До 300 слов.
items.evidence: If applicable, please share any special circumstances-such as personal or familyrelated challenges-or additional information that would help us better understand your background, experiences, or difficulties you have overcome. (Maximum: 300 words)

items.ru: Одно письмо, только по официальной форме POSTECH; отправляет сам рекомендатель до срока подачи.
items.evidence: Only ONE recommendation letter will be considered, using the official POSTECH recommendation form. The letter should be submitted directly by the recommender no later than the submission deadline.

items.ru: По желанию: список до 10 наград, почётных грамот, волонтёрства и клубов за старшую школу по важности, на официальной форме; к каждому пункту нужно подтверждение. Всего до 30 односторонних страниц.
items.evidence: Applicants may list up to 10 items of honors, awards, and extracurricular activities during high school in order of importance using the designated form (Supplementary Materials List Form), and each item must be supported by relevant documents or other verifiable evidence (e.g., certificates or testimonials). Supporting documents may be submitted as supplementary materials of up to 30 one-sided pages in total.

items.ru: Если нужно что-то пояснить о заявке (гражданство, родство, перерывы): объяснительная записка на официальной форме с подтверждающими документами.
items.evidence: Applicants who need to clarify any admission-related matters must submit an explanatory statement (in English or Korean) using the designated explanatory statement form, along with official or verifiable supporting documents, during the application period.

note: Снимок 2026-09-26, набор Spring 2027. Личное заявление — 4 вопроса, четвёртый только при особых обстоятельствах. Награды, волонтёрство и клубы идут одним списком в пункте activities. Собеседования на международном треке нет: «Interview is NOT required for International Admissions Track».
